text:
anya: idea: let sidecars propose local fallbacks but always attach a decision_id so we can audit/replay.
liam: sidecar-local requests = fast. but need central arbiter to avoid flip-flop.
todd: agree. sidecar emits to kafka topic `decisions.request` with payload like `{decision_id, node, signal, value}`. arbiter replies on `decisions.response`.
emily: UX: operator inbox card shows: time, service, requestor, trigger, confidence, outcome. expand -> 15s signal window + link to playback.
anya: toggle in rollout policy: "permit local fallback requests" with threshold, cooldown, notify-level. default OFF for prod tenants.
liam: require cooldown and hysteresis. also classify requests as "implicit" vs "operator".
emily: audit retention 90d, exportable JSON/CSV. require override modal with short reason.
todd: security: mTLS + per-node signer token; audit logs cert thumbprint. ops-bot: infra note - we already index sidecar.* metrics but need to add decision_id.
anya: pilot plan: metrics-only mode (requests emitted but arbiter never accepts) in single pool. action items: eng-runtime add decision_id header (owner: todd), platform add arbiter API + audit schema (owner: liam), ux mock (owner: emily).
liam: +1. let's RFC and feature-flag it. ops-bot: created INFRA-1209 for sidecar fallback pilot.
